question: Identify the chemical formula for ethyne.
solution:
The correct answer is __**C₂H₂**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The chemical formula of ethyne is C2H2.
 
• Ethyne is a colorless gas at atmospheric pressure and room temperature.
 
• It is unstable in pure-form solution.
 
• It is an unsaturated hydrocarbon as it has a triple bond between two carbon atoms.
